checkpoint_selection: last EMA at the declared update budget

conversion_check.description: For a valid demonstration label, active-frame encoding followed by decoding against the same pre-action observation reconstructs the demonstrated commanded world TCP pose. The framework checks FK position in metres, rotation angle in radians and unchanged gripper scalar; nonunique IK is allowed. Gram-Schmidt only projects sampled non-orthogonal 6D rotations.

contract.cut_relation: Covers every assigned action in each [0,470) segment. It retains high approach, drawer-front acquisition and pull, release and retreat, red approach/closure and initial lift, including all 240 action-supervised steps 230:470 overlapping red_transfer in every demonstration.
contract.output_semantics: Each slot is an absolute TCP target relative to the active frame at that slot's pre-action state: position [3] in metres, rotation as the first two columns [6] of the active-frame rotation matrix, and native gripper scalar [1]. The articulated drawer frame is active unless drawer_position is at least red_phase_min_open_m and either TCP-minus-red world-Z clearance is at least red_phase_clearance_m or TCP/red world-XY distance is at most red_phase_xy_radius_m; then the observed red pose is active. Prediction slots are t-1 through t+14 and execution uses slots 1 through 8 for t through t+7. At each physical execution step the active frame is recomputed from the fresh observation, 6D rotation is projected by Gram-Schmidt, the represented target is transformed to a world TCP pose, and panda_kinematics.solve_ik produces absolute arm-joint targets from freshly measured qpos. The gripper scalar is appended unchanged and the common executor maps its sign to open or close.
contract.parameter_semantics: drawer_origin_world_m is the current world-frame origin in metres of the drawer at drawer_position=0. drawer_orientation_wxyz is its unit wxyz orientation and defines local -X opening translation. desired_open_position_m is the intended opening in metres, bound to the demonstrated 0.300 m. red_phase_min_open_m is the minimum observed opening for red-frame eligibility, bound to 0.280 m. red_phase_clearance_m is the minimum world-Z TCP-above-red clearance for the high-retreat branch, bound to 0.280 m. red_phase_xy_radius_m is the world-XY TCP/red radius retaining red-frame use during approach, descent and lift, bound to 0.140 m. These are calibration and intent values; fresh physical observations select the active frame.
